about_item: ✅ What You See Is What You Get: You'll receive a delicately designed and well constructed dog bed, which fits into any home décor. Quality assured. If you have any questions about the dog bed, simply reach out to our customer service team. All your issues will be friendly & swiftly resolved.

✅ Better Than Most Dog Beds On The Market: Our memory foam dog bed is built with materials of higher quality standard, making it more durable but yet more accessible pricewise.It is a full 50" large and 34” wide, made of 7” thick memory foam that relieves pressure on joints and features a 3” thick headrest that supports the dog's head, for unparalleled support and optimal comfort.
✅ Soothing Comfort: The orthopedic dog bed sofa has a styled faux linen exterior with a textured plush top providing ultimate soothing comfort that have your pet sink into oblivion.

✅ Waterproof & Easy Care: The washable zippered cover itself is waterproof and prevents urine, water, saliva, vomit and other liquid into the foam and can be easily removed for machine washing & cleaning. Machine wash, gentle cycle, Tumble dry, low heat. Note: Please note that the foam insert is not washble.
✅ Durable & Secure : The non-skid bottom is crafted of solid oxford to withstand the wear and tear of daily use. Substantial amount of silicone dots at the bottom prevents it from sliding.

authors_reviews.title: Perfect for our German shepherd!
authors_reviews.text: The thickness and size were perfect for out German Shepherd. She seemed very comfortable and the quality was good for the price. It has held its shape for 2 years now. The cover is easy to wash and put back on. I definitely let it air dry though and did not put it in the dryer.
authors_reviews.author: Jess

authors_reviews.title: Dog fell asleep immediately! ❤️
authors_reviews.text: Received bed yesterday. Took it out of the box, put the cover on (very easy) and my dog immediately got on it and fell asleep! 😊 I’d say it’s a hit! I bought 2 beds for different rooms. He slept on the other one last night, and we didn’t hear a peep out of him all night. No turning in circles, moving about trying to get comfortable. I bought the largest size as he’s a 105 lbs, and needs plenty of room to stretch out. Top of cover is SO SOFT! He naps a LOT, and this bed is AWESOME! Haven’t washed it yet, but looks like other covers off old bed and never had an issue with those. Zipper seems sturdy.
authors_reviews.author: OnlineShopaholic!

authors_reviews.title: Nice bed and worth the price
authors_reviews.text: The bed was nice and big as described. It is memory foam and very cushy for my dogs. The only complaint I have is that the inner cover that zips on was very thin and did not fit over the foam mattress so it was unusable. The outer fur cover was a tight fit but I was able to get it over the foam mattress with a bit of a struggle but it looks great. Quality is above average overall.

authors_reviews.title: Your dog will thank you
authors_reviews.text: My dog loves this bed! Its comfortable, it's waterproof, it gives her the perfect support she needs, easy to wash and it does not hold the dog smell. It's super thick so it's super durable.

authors_reviews.title: Defective Cover
authors_reviews.text: The zipper immediately broke when trying to put the cover on the bed. I tried to reach out to the email that was provided in the box for customer support and haven't received a reply. I think the bed is the perfect size and cushioning for my older 110 lbs dog, but I would love a replacement cover. If someone can please help me get a new cover, I'd be happy to change my review on this product.
